glosses: immigrant (person who comes to a country to settle)

examples.text: Muitos dos imigrantes mudaram de nome.
examples.en: Many of the immigrants changed their names.

examples.text: Tom é um imigrante da Austrália.
examples.en: Tom is an immigrant from Australia.

examples.text: A maioria dos americanos descende de imigrantes.
examples.en: Most Americans are descended from immigrants.
